name: Great Plains Zoo Junior Zookeeper (JZK)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer all summer at the zoo. First-year jobs are helping at ZooCamp or greeting guests and running story time. Returning teens can care for farm animals and present animals.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18 on June 1, 2026. Animal Care Assistants must be at least 14 and have done JZK the summer before. Advanced JZK is for returning 17 year olds.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens pay a fee after they are accepted: $85 for zoo members, $100 for non-members. It covers materials and two uniform t-shirts. Scholarships may be available.
duration: Whole summer; the 2026 session ran through August 9. At least two half-day shifts a week.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 6 (returning teens) and March 27 (new teens). 2027 dates are not posted. Email Education@GPZoo.org to be told when applications open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Then go to a 20 minute in-person interview. After you are accepted, pay the fee. Give a negative TB test by orientation. Then go to orientation.
notes: Teens arrange their own lunch and transportation. Contact: Education@GPZoo.org or (605) 367-7003. 2026 new teen interviews were April 11 and 12, so expect the 2027 cycle to start in winter or early spring.
